list: The official 55 PS5 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them. Names, descriptions and grades cross-checked across the numbered sources in sources.json (read 20 Nov 2026). Guide text is written for this entry in its own words; every step cites the sources its facts came from.

trophies.dispute: How long the platinum takes is disputed: PowerPyx, KeenGamer, GTABase, GTA-Zone, GTA Vibes and OutputLag all say about 200 hours, while Push Square says 300 hours or more. Whether cheats block trophies is also unsettled: PowerPyx and GTABase say yes, GTASpotter (citing PC Gamer) says it is not yet known.
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are all yours. Everything is single-player, so no online or DLC trophy stands in the way; the road is long (about 200 hours by most guides) but rated only 4/10 for difficulty.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies. There is nothing extra to do for the platinum itself; it pops as soon as the last one lands.
Plan for roughly 200 hours at difficulty 4/10, in a single playthrough, with no online trophies and no mission gold medals to chase.
Keep cheats off your trophy save: most guides say using one disables trophies and saving, and there is no mission replay to fall back on.
Rarity is 0.03% on Exophase the day after launch, which just means almost nobody has had time to finish yet.

trophies.gate: Chapter 1 — Gone Fishing, the opening mission
trophies.guide: The first story trophy: finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.text: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first mission of the story.
The trophy pops when the mission ends. It is automatic and cannot be missed.
At 99.99% on Exophase it is the most-earned trophy in the set, as expected for the opener.

trophies.dispute: When it pops is a small point of disagreement: the description says complete Chapter 1, but PowerPyx and GTABase both say it actually unlocks after the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, and OutputLag notes chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. If it does not pop at once, keep playing into Chapter 2 — guides report it lands after the first Chapter 2 mission.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.text: Play through all of Chapter 1's main missions, ending with Down to Earth.
If the trophy has not popped when the chapter ends, play the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? — that is when PowerPyx and GTABase say it unlocks.
Before leaving Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude): it is the one thing in the chapter that can be missed.

trophies.dispute: As with the other chapter trophies, PowerPyx and GTABase say it pops after the first mission of the next chapter (Welcome to Vice City) rather than the moment Chapter 2 ends.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The trophy is reported to pop as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.text: Play through Chapter 2's main missions, including Breakfast Run and Coffee Break.
If it does not pop at the chapter's end, play Welcome to Vice City, the first mission of Chapter 3.
Coffee Break unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia and playing together, which opens the partner trophies.

trophies.dispute: PowerPyx and GTABase say this one pops later than the description suggests: after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Guides report it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.text: Play through Chapter 3's main missions, including The Cartel Heist.
Keep playing into Chapter 4: PowerPyx and GTABase say the trophy lands after Ocean Beach and Another Life.
Use Chapter 3 to start the questlines that open here: Andy (Lucia-only), Randy's wish list and Tyrone's labs.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, including the final main mission Starting From Zero. Automatic and unmissable.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.text: Play through Chapter 4's main missions, including Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown.
PowerPyx says it unlocks after the final main mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero.
Keep a manual save before the final stretch: there is no mission replay, so a chapter save is your only way back.

trophies.dispute: Which chapter holds the final mission is unclear: PowerPyx ties both this trophy and the Chapter 4 trophy to Starting From Zero, while eGamers notes other lists word the final mission as Chapter 5, and Operation Savage Glory (Snow Storm) is firmly a Chapter 5 mission in PowerPyx and GTABase.
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Free roam continues after the credits, so everything else can be cleaned up afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Play the story through to its final mission and complete it. The trophy pops with the credits.
Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission: there is no mission replay and no New Game+.
After the credits you return to free roam and the 100% Completion checklist opens under Progress > Stats, which is where the long grind for A Long Road begins.

trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission. Automatic and unmissable.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.text: Play Chapter 2 until Breakfast Run appears and complete it.
The trophy pops during the mission. It cannot be missed.
OutputLag says switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run, which is when the partner trophies start to become possible.

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission. Automatic and unmissable.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.text: Play Chapter 3 until The Cartel Heist appears and complete it.
The trophy pops during the mission. It cannot be missed.
It is one of the three 25G story trophies on Xbox, alongside Hi-Jacked and Snow Storm.

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission. Automatic and unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.text: Play Chapter 4 until Child's Play appears and complete it.
The trophy pops during the mission. It cannot be missed.
Chapter 4 is also when the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… opens bank vault robberies, so take it when it appears.

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 story mission. Automatic and unmissable.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.text: Play Chapter 4 until Headliners appears and complete it.
The trophy pops during the mission. It cannot be missed.
There are no mission gold medals in GTA VI, so no hidden objective can cost you the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 story mission at the airport. Automatic and unmissable.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.text: Play Chapter 4 until VCIA Takedown appears and complete it.
The trophy pops during the mission. It cannot be missed.
The mission takes you to Vice City International Airport, the same place Catch Me If You Can is earned later.

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 story mission. Automatic and unmissable.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.text: Play Chapter 5 until Operation Savage Glory appears and complete it.
The trophy pops during the mission. It cannot be missed.
GTABase and GTA-Zone both place this mission in Chapter 5, the last chapter.

trophies.dispute: How demanding 100% really is divides the guides: PowerPyx calls the checklist roughly 60% of true completion with lenient thresholds, while Push Square says you must do almost everything. The total time is disputed too (about 200 hours in most guides, 300+ in Push Square).
trophies.gate: After the story — the checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the longest grind: finish the 100% Completion checklist. It is lenient — most categories ask for only part of the total — but it still takes about 100 hours after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: Finish the story first: the checklist only appears afterwards (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), though progress made during the story already counts.

Clear the categories that need everything: all robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), all 33 underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.

Hit the partial targets: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 30 of 40 races won.
Nothing on the checklist is missable and everything stays doable in free roam after the credits, so work through it at your own pace.
Rarity is 0.03% on Exophase the day after launch; nobody has had time for a 100-hour checklist yet.

trophies.dispute: KeenGamer calls the target 250 unique stunts, while PowerPyx, GTABase and Push Square say any 250 of the 397 count, in any mix. The Gamerscore is disputed too: GTABase and OutputLag give 40G, while eGamers notes individual Gamerscore values do not match from list to list.
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. Keep going to 300 — the 100% checklist wants more.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: Pick from four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — 397 in total, and any 250 count.
Flying under bridges is the quickest kind to rack up, according to PowerPyx and GTABase; the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed, just performing it once counts.
Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and find stunt spots on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Do not stop at 250: the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going while you are at it.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, an arcade game, a race win and a stunt. Most come naturally during the story.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.text: Do one of each of the 9 types: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race, and a stunt.
Check what is left under Touchpad > Progress > Activities; the story introduces most types on its own.
Activities show as blue dumbbell icons on the map when you filter for them, so mop up any missing type in free roam.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.dispute: How many shooting ranges exist is genuinely disputed: PowerPyx and GTABase say 42 gold medals across 12 ranges, while Push Square names just two ranges (Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn, Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero) and OutputLag also says two ranges hold the 42 medals. GTASpotter's challenge list likewise speaks of earning a medal at both shooting ranges.
trophies.gate: Shooting ranges (some challenges are locked until other conditions are met)
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.text: Work through the Shooting Range challenges and earn a gold medal in each of the 42.
Push Square says some challenges have three difficulty tiers and some are locked until you meet other conditions, which the map shows.
Track progress under Touchpad > Activities > Shooting Ranges; the 100% checklist needs all 42 golds as well.
Range practice raises your Focus level, which makes the Gunslinger trophy easier later.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants all 42 races.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.text: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations with 42 races between them; win at least one race at each location.
Find locations on the map under Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones; Push Square notes some races charge an entry fee.
Finish all 42 races while you are there — the 100% checklist needs every one of them.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. Winning the same race twice does not count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.text: There are 40 unique races; win 20 different ones. Repeating a win does not count.
Track them under Activities > Racing on the map; most locations let you hire a car, and your own car's rating matters if you bring it.
The 100% checklist wants 30 of the 40 won, plus 10 of 13 race-challenge gold medals, so keep racing past 20.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After you meet him in Feng Shui he texts you and marks a fishing spot west of Key Lento.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.text: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui. Some time later he texts you and marks a fishing location with a purple icon west of Key Lento.
Push Square says his request is a Parrotfish over 2kg; fish in the marked area until you land one big enough.
Play through his fishing quests and beat him in the challenge to pop the trophy.
At 1.89% on Exophase it is the second most-earned trophy after the opener, since it comes so early.

trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade (video) games: finish all its levels once. Three are on the TV at home from Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.text: Pick one of the 4 video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade cabinets around Leonida.
Finish all levels of one game at least once. You do not need to beat every challenge, just reach the end.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.dispute: Whether Andy's chain can expire is disputed: PowerPyx and GTABase say all her quests stay available after the story, while eGamers reports a single source (TechWiser) warning that stranger chains behind five hidden trophies have windows linked to story progress. Start it as soon as it unlocks, to be safe.
trophies.gate: Chapter 3, Lucia-only — Andy calls Lucia, then texts her address in Belville
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's five quests, Lucia-only, starting in Chapter 3. The last one, Puff Puff Pass, pops the trophy.
trophies.missable_note: One source warns stranger chains may have story-linked windows; PowerPyx and GTABase say Andy's quests stay open after the story. Start the chain as soon as it appears and finish it promptly.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.text: In Chapter 3, while playing as Lucia, Andy calls and then texts her home address, marking the questline in Belville. The chain is Lucia-only.
Complete the five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass.
The trophy pops on finishing Puff Puff Pass, meeting at the warehouse.
Do not leave the chain sitting: eGamers cites one source warning of story-linked windows on stranger chains, even though the main guides say it stays open.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.dispute: Kenton genuinely disappears for a stretch of the story, which is why the single-source warning about story-linked windows (reported by eGamers) matters here more than most: PowerPyx and GTABase both say he comes back and the quests stay open after the story.
trophies.guide: Clear Kenton's 7 shipwreck treasure quests. He vanishes after Chapter 1 but returns later — call Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 to speed it up.
trophies.missable_note: Kenton is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1; PowerPyx and GTABase say he returns in Chapter 2–3 and the quests stay open after the story. Finish his chain when he reappears rather than leaving it.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.text: After the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, Kenton calls and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Clear his 7 shipwrecks: dive at the purple treasure-chest markers and use the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor, then bring it back to him.
After Chapter 1 he goes quiet for a while; PowerPyx says he texts Jason again in Chapter 2–3, and calling Brian as Jason later in Chapter 2 speeds it up.
Push Square names the final mission Maritime Disputes; track progress under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.gate: After Chapter 2 — Coffee Break; Thrillbilly Mudclub, Kelly County
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's five jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub. The last one, Hometown Heroes, pops the trophy.
trophies.missable_note: One source warns stranger chains may have story-linked windows; PowerPyx and GTABase say Billy's quests stay open after the story. Start the chain when it appears.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Billy's questline is marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete the five jobs in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, then Hometown Heroes.
The trophy pops on finishing Hometown Heroes. All five stay available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.dispute: Two disagreements sit on this trophy. First, only four qualifying strands are confirmed (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete); PowerPyx and GTABase both say the rest are still being confirmed. Second, OutputLag says Yago's Race Against Yago carries an hourglass and is time-sensitive, while PowerPyx and GTASpotter say hourglass quests are not relevant for trophies.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands. Only some count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not — so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand.
trophies.missable_note: Yago's Chapter 3 race (Race Against Yago) carries an hourglass icon and may expire; OutputLag says do it the moment it appears and save first. PowerPyx and GTASpotter say hourglass quests do not count for trophies — the warning is disputed, so do the race promptly either way.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.text: Finish strands for the confirmed qualifying strangers: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries).
Do not count the questlines with their own trophies: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one.
The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed by the guides, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list after each strand you finish.
Do Yago's Race Against Yago as soon as it appears in Chapter 3: OutputLag flags it as timed (hourglass icon). Save first, then race.
Stranger strands are not needed for 100% and stay available after the story, so this is a Stage 3 cleanup trophy.

trophies.unconfirmed_note: Only four of the eight qualifying strands are confirmed (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete). The guides say more are still being confirmed, so the full set of eight is not yet known.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.gate: After Chapter 3 — Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Key Cloner)
trophies.guide: Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List to his garage in west Vice City. Scan cars with WAiNK to see if they are on the list.
trophies.missable_note: One source warns stranger chains may have story-linked windows; PowerPyx and GTABase say Randy's list stays open after the story. Work through the list steadily rather than leaving it all to the end.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.text: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS you unlock the Key Cloner and deliver a Zorrusso to Randy, opening his wish list of 16 sports cars.
Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is wanted, then drive it to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City).
Good hunting grounds are the east of Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, where sports cars park outside hotels; delivering in good condition pays more.
The trophy pops when the 16th car is delivered. The list can still be done after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.gate: After Chapter 3 — Here, Kitty Kitty; Jason-only
trophies.guide: Destroy Tyrone's synthetic labs around Vice City, then complete his final job, Spin On This. Jason-only.
trophies.missable_note: One source warns stranger chains may have story-linked windows; PowerPyx and GTABase say Tyrone's quests stay open after the story. Start the labs when they appear.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.text: After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, Tyrone's questline opens for Jason only. Purple markers show the synthetic labs around Vice City.
Destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. They are part of the questline, not free-roam targets.
Once enough labs are gone, Tyrone gives his final job, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), which pops the trophy.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.dispute: Three open questions sit on this trophy. Whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required is unconfirmed in every guide (PowerPyx, KeenGamer, GTABase, OutputLag, eGamers). PowerPyx and GTA-Zone say 18 spots in 10 locations, while Push Square calls them 18 meditation locations. And eGamers notes sources disagree on the count itself, 18 against 15, which may mean the trophy and the 100% checklist count different things.
trophies.gate: Chapter 1 balcony meditation (missable) + after Chapter 2 — Coffee Break for the final meditation
trophies.guide: THE missable trophy. Meditate at all 18 spots, and above all do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — it is gone after that chapter, and nobody has confirmed whether the trophy needs it.
trophies.missable_note: The first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. Do it the morning after Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony, choose Accept. Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.text: In Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen. When she says she is going to meditate, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept.
That first meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a spot, and no guide has confirmed whether it is required — do it anyway, and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2, so bring your partner every time.
The final meditation needs both characters playable together, which unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18, so the missable one cannot cost you A Long Road — but it might cost you this trophy.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.gate: After Chapter 2 — Coffee Break; Jason-only (Bret texts Jason)
trophies.guide: Work through Bret Vogel's hunting questline as Jason. Which animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed — complete his Target Decks and it should come along the way.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.text: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, Bret Vogel texts Jason (Lucia cannot receive it) and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. The chain is Jason-only.
Hunt the animals he requests on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back to Bret as Jason. There are 15 Target Decks in total.
During the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required.
No guide has confirmed which animal unlocks the trophy yet. The 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so finishing the chain is the safe route.

trophies.unconfirmed_note: PowerPyx, GTABase, GTA-Zone and eGamers all say it is still unconfirmed which animal triggers this trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets. The 100% checklist needs 15, so this pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.text: There are 18 Collectible Card sets; complete any 3 of them.
Track each set's progress under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
Cards you have collected can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward your progress.
The 100% checklist needs 15 full sets, so keep collecting past 3.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app: any mix of landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags counts.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up on the D-pad) and scan objects in the environment by holding R1.
Any 100 scans count, from 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags — there are more than 100 in total.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
The 100% checklist also needs 100 WAiNK scans, so the two finish together.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 Challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so leave the 10 hardest for last — or skip them entirely.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.text: There are 80 Challenges in eight groups of ten (Combat, Crime, Exploration, Fitness, Shopping, Sports, Survival, Vehicles), available from the start.
Complete any 50. Many finish on their own while you work on other trophies, so leave this one late and mop up the easiest remaining ones.
Track them under Progress > Challenges; a checkmark in the bottom right shows a completed one.
The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so you can skip the 10 hardest entirely.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.dispute: When partner play unlocks is disputed: OutputLag says switching opens right after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2, while PowerPyx and GTABase say it comes after Coffee Break. Either way, you need both characters free-roaming together.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star Wanted Level and escape the red heat zone. Bank vault robberies give 4 stars automatically, so it often pops there.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.text: Wait until both characters can free-roam together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2), then call your partner by holding Right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle.
Cause enough trouble to reach a 4-star Wanted Level, then escape until you are out of the red heat zone — leaving the flashing search area is not enough.
The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. A fast sports motorcycle also works.
It often pops on its own during bank vault robberies, which always give 4 stars.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.dispute: As with Hot Together, the partner unlock is disputed: OutputLag says right after Breakfast Run, PowerPyx and GTABase say after Coffee Break.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together — ideal for the chain.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.text: Call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle) and gear up first: body armor, sticky bombs and healing items from Ammu-Nation.
Rob 3 shops in a row while the red-and-blue flashing Wanted Level stays up. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks.
A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. Rob a couple of items in each and break the safe with sticky bombs.
The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop. If it does not, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK or getting inside them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.text: Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it — you do not need to drive it. Push Square adds that getting inside one counts too.
Stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic; the game has 557 vehicles at launch across cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes.
Track discoveries under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles, which shows totals per category.
The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so this trophy comes on the way.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one Combat Focus (slow-motion aim). Fill your Focus first, use an assault rifle, and pick gang enemies — cops, soldiers and civilians do not count.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.text: Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar.
Fill your Focus before you start (eat, drink, or wash up at home) and use Adrenaline to make it last longer. Wear body armor so you can step out of cover.
Line up 5 gang enemies — the guards at an illegal operation work well — and drop them with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.
It gets easier as your Focus levels up (4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots), so it may pop naturally late in the game.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA (gates E3/E4 are easiest), take off, and fly about 1 km away.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.text: At VCIA, pick a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Gates E3/E4 are the easiest.
Drive through a fence around the airfield and head for the plane; next to the boarding bridge are stairs with a door leading straight inside. Or enter on foot through the terminal.
Go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before the trophy pops.
Save first: the police come fast once you are in the plane.

trophies.dispute: Where Mile Zero Air Station sits is worded differently: PowerPyx and GTABase put it on the south-west island of Mariana County, while OutputLag describes it as Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys. Both point to the same base in the south-west of the map.
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino) from Mile Zero Air Station in the south-west of the map and take out enemies from inside it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.text: Head to Mile Zero Air Station, the island in the south-west edge of the map. The tanks stand in the south of the base.
Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, then climb into a tank.
Shoot enemies from inside the tank until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.gate: After Chapter 3 — Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Snap Gun)
trophies.guide: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun, slip in a jewelry store's back door, find the safe code, empty the safe and leave unseen.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.text: First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. It gives you the Snap Gun and unlocks jewelry store robberies, marked with green icons.
Use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm. In the back room, find the note with the safe code and open the safe.
Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room, then leave without being seen. The trophy pops shortly after you leave.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If anyone spots you, reload and try again.

trophies.dispute: One guide gets the grade wrong: Push Square lists Maximum Withdrawal as a Bronze trophy, while every other source — PowerPyx, GTABase, OutputLag, GTA-Zone, GTA Vibes, eGamers — lists it as Silver, which is the official grade.
trophies.gate: After Chapter 4 — optional mission That's Where The Money Is…
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. Vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…; each pays up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.text: First do the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe). It introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the guard has the vault open, and rob it.
You cannot carry all the cash alone — bring your partner and hand off a bag.
Afterwards, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 (after his earlier quests), marking vans with purple icons. Follow them to their banks.
Each vault instantly gives a 4-star Wanted Level: escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. Five vaults earn the trophy; the 100% checklist needs all 8.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.gate: After Chapter 4 — That's Where The Money Is… (or any armored truck on the street)
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. Robbing a bank vault counts — or box in a truck on the street and blow its back doors with a sticky bomb.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.text: The easiest route is a bank vault robbery (see Maximum Withdrawal): robbing the vault counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank.
Or do it earlier: box in an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open.
Either way, the trophy only pops once you escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida. Flying a plane over the dark patches is the fastest way.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.text: You need to clear the fog from every part of the map. The quickest way is by plane, flying over all the dark patches.
The map shows fogged areas in black; keep flying until the whole state is visible.
Exploring as you play the story and side content clears much of it naturally, so this is a late Stage 2 cleanup.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this pops along the way.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.text: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations. Rob one operation belonging to each gang.
Operations show as yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress.
Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs: scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
The 100% checklist needs all 39, so keep robbing past the first 9.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.dispute: PowerPyx gives exact steps (Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar), but KeenGamer, GTABase, GTA-Zone, OutputLag and eGamers all still list this trophy as unconfirmed. PowerPyx is the only source with a confirmed method, and it is the one this guide follows.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it standing next to the bar. PowerPyx confirms this method; other guides still list it as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.text: Head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach in Vice City.
Buy an Apple Martini at the bar.
Drink it while standing next to the bar to pop the trophy.
KeenGamer, GTABase, GTA-Zone and eGamers still list the exact trigger as unconfirmed — PowerPyx is the only guide with a tested method, so follow it and check the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.dispute: PowerPyx gives exact steps (the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom, after the Key Cloner), but KeenGamer, GTABase, GTA-Zone, OutputLag and eGamers all still list this trophy as unconfirmed. PowerPyx is the only source with a confirmed method.
trophies.gate: After Chapter 3 — Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Key Cloner)
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the window. Only that car counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.text: First get the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee inside.
Drive forward straight through the showroom window. The trophy pops a little later, once you are further down the street.
Only the blue Banshee unlocks it — no other car works.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.gate: Chapter 2 — optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe. You do not need all three in one visit.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.text: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs.

Take the 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it open with a sticky bomb).
The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. Killing the enemies is not necessary.
Not missable: if you leave something behind, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can go back for the rest.

trophies.dispute: When partner play unlocks is disputed: OutputLag says switching opens right after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2, while PowerPyx and GTABase say it comes after Coffee Break. Either way, both characters must be playable together.
trophies.gate: After Chapter 2 — Coffee Break (both characters playable)
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out together — while one trains, the other trains too.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.text: Wait until you can switch between both characters (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2).
Buy a gym membership and work out with your partner along (hold Right, press Triangle to call them). While you actively train with one character, the other completes their training automatically.
Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength (heart icon). Find fitness clubs via Map > Activities.
After the story you can also work out at home. The trophy pops when both characters are at maximum Strength at once.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. It fills passively through robberies and fights — but avoid the Irredeemable profile, which is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.text: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — robberies, stealthy objectives, clean escapes, incapacitating or killing enemies. Clicking the trophy in the trophy list shows your count.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) to watch a small demon face appear each time an action counts.
Do not push toward the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent, and cops become more aggressive. eGamers notes this count comes from a single source, so treat the 500 as a guide, not gospel.
It usually pops on its own while working on other trophies. If it is the last one left, running over civilians and cops with a car farms it fast — at the cost of your profile.

trophies.dispute: Nobody has confirmed this one, and the two guesses differ: PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner, while GTABase only reads the description as succeeding at something on a second attempt. KeenGamer, GTA-Zone, OutputLag and eGamers all list it as unconfirmed.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has a tested method yet. The best lead is the Payday Loans store from the Prologue in Little Cuba: try robbing it again later. Do not chase this one until a method is confirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.text: No published guide has a confirmed method for this trophy as of 20 Nov 2026. Every source lists it as unknown.
PowerPyx's best guess: it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue in Little Cuba, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner.
GTABase reads the description, 'Second time's the charm', as succeeding at something on a second attempt — a guess, not a tested method.
Leave this trophy until a method is confirmed. Check back on PowerPyx or GTABase rather than guessing blindly.

trophies.unconfirmed_note: No guide has a confirmed unlock method as of 20 Nov 2026. PowerPyx's Payday Loans lead and GTABase's second-attempt reading are both guesses.

trophies.dispute: PowerPyx cracked this one: it is the UFO easter egg north-west of Starlet Motel. But the other guides disagree — KeenGamer, GTABase, GTA-Zone and eGamers still list it as unconfirmed, and OutputLag offers two different unconfirmed leads (a glowing-graffiti code in Crosstown, and a keypad code for the Abandoned Site north-east of Cottonmouth Lake). This guide follows PowerPyx, the only source with a tested method.
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED by PowerPyx: the UFO easter egg. Go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 AM, follow the blinking car into the woods, and help the woman the UFO drops.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.text: Go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2 AM. The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed.
Look for a blinking car parked at the roadside. If it is not there, drive away and come back.
Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods until you see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted.
Talk to her, offer to help, then walk back to her car at the roadside to pop the trophy.
OutputLag lists two other unconfirmed leads — a glowing-graffiti code in Crosstown and a keypad at the Abandoned Site — but PowerPyx's UFO method is the only tested one.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.dispute: PowerPyx gives exact steps (ride a bike and kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds), but KeenGamer, GTABase, GTA-Zone, OutputLag and eGamers all still list the precise method as unconfirmed. PowerPyx is the only source with a confirmed method.
trophies.guide: Ride a bike and kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds, in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach. PowerPyx confirms this method; other guides still list it as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.text: Get on any bike and ride into a crowded area, such as Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds to pop the trophy.
KeenGamer, GTABase, GTA-Zone and eGamers still list the precise method as unconfirmed — PowerPyx is the only guide with a tested method, so follow it and check the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.gate: After Chapter 3 — Credit Check (Dye Pack Jammer)
trophies.guide: Launder a running total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through fences. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one robbery, and Yasmani pays the most.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.text: First finish Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence. Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 is a running total across all robberies — you do not need to bring it all at once.
Bank vaults (unlocked in Chapter 4) pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so the 100% robberies get you there naturally.

trophies.guide: Spend a running total of $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.text: Spend a total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. It is a running total, so normal spending counts.
The fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos — the most expensive purchases in the game.
Leonida has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores and more, so you will not run out of places to spend.

trophies.gate: After Chapter 2 — Daily Driver (Vice City Real Estate app)
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate app, about $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone.
Buy the 8 purchasable garages through the app — about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count.
Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value jobs in Chapters 3–4.
Garages also add parking spots, which you need for On the Spot registrations.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.gate: After Chapter 2 — Moses mission (Scooter Bros app)
trophies.guide: Register 10 stolen vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Take them to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register — and buy garages first, since each car needs a free space.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.text: The Scooter Bros app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission with Moses. It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you.
Buy garages first (see Little Boxes): each garage adds parking spots, and each registration needs a free space.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage choose Respray, then Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers.
From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the cost down.
